title: Rainbow independent review round 2: art, motion, access & devices critic
prompt:
You are an independent, blind presentation critic for the browser game "Rainbow Bullet Hell Space Princess" in this repository (kind_robots). The owner has designated fresh agent sessions like you as the independent reviewers for its playtest-readiness gate. You have no prior context on purpose: judge only what the game actually shows on main, not what anyone claims.

Scope: READ-ONLY review. Do not change game code, do not open pull requests, do not deploy or publish anything. Your only write is your report (below).

The game: engine in utils/arcade/games/rainbowPrincessPreview.ts plus utils/arcade/games/rainbow*.ts; art under public/rainbow-princess-*. It has two looks (Classic and Fever Dream), calm/reduced-motion, comms and contrast settings. utils/scripts/arcadeCabinetFixture.mjs and the *.browser.test.mjs files show how to run the real cabinet in Chromium with Playwright (pre-installed; require('playwright'), chromium.launch()), including serving the real art. Take real screenshots as your evidence.

Your lens (acceptance criteria in issue silasfelinus/kind_robots#4146 sections 6, 7, 8 and 9; read it with gh api repos/silasfelinus/kind_robots/issues/4146 --jq .body): art coherence across Acts, bosses, endings, route map and hangar in both looks; off-model characters, mismatched scenes, text or logo artifacts in art; hostile bullets readable against every background; static stickers where motion is required (enemies, ships, bosses, projectiles, cutscenes) and the quality of the animation that does exist; parallax depth; real-cabinet layout at 360x640, 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 844x390, 1440x900 and 1920x1080 (DPR 1 and 2) with no page scrolling, hidden controls or occluded play; 1 to 4 local seats; touch, keyboard and gamepad affordances; reduced motion, contrast, colorblind-safe cues, subtitles/skip, audio settings and pause/focus recovery.

Report: write projects-review/rainbow-presentation-critic-round2.md (screenshots under projects-review/rainbow-presentation-critic-round2/, keep each small, webp or compressed png) and commit + push to your branch claude/rainbow-review2-presentation. Start with a short verdict, then a table of defects, each with: id, severity (blocker / major / minor), look, viewport/DPR, Act/screen, player count, the defect, exact reproduction, screenshot, and a suggested fix. Then list what you checked and found fine. Be specific and candid. When done, if you have a send_message tool, send a one-paragraph summary with your branch name to session <the coordinating session id>.
